dct_description_sm: "Lee's famous "hog-snout" line." "Read numerically." Maps 1 to 4 are dated 1933 and maps 5 to 12 dated 1935. Annotated in pen-and-ink, crayon and pencil. Confederate troop positions are colored red and Union positions are blue. Call no. cited in LC Civil War maps (2nd ed.): G1292.S6S5 .R 1935 folio. Includes notes. Library of Congress.
